claim: Compound XYZ has completed human clinical testing and is officially approved for human Alzheimer's treatment.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: The underlying research was conducted exclusively in transgenic mice with no human clinical trials conducted.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: Treatment restored synaptic density exclusively in 6-month-old APP/PS1 transgenic mice; clinical trials in humans have not been conducted.
Preclinical findings in animal models require rigorous multi-phase human clinical trials before safety and efficacy can be established.
